heading: Appropriations
lead: There are appropriated to the James Madison Memorial Trust Fund $20,000,000 to carry out the provisions of this chapter, $10,000,000 of which shall be available on November 1, 1987, and to remain available until expended; and $10,000,000 of which shall be available on November 1, 1988, and to remain available until expended.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 99–591 is a corrected version of Pub. L. 99–500.
